primitives.name: REAL_METRIC
primitives.carrier: Symmetric bilinear inner product / Riemannian metric tensor g(u, v)
primitives.operational_meaning: Distance, angle, scalar projection, Gram matrix G >= 0

primitives.name: ORIENTATION_SYMPLECTIC
primitives.carrier: Alternating differential 2-form w(u, v) / oriented bivector / J^2 = -I
primitives.operational_meaning: Phase rotation, canonical commutation, Lie bracket orientation, symplectic area

primitives.name: CONVEX_COMPOSITION
primitives.carrier: Convex combination sum p_i x_i (p_i >= 0, sum p_i = 1)
primitives.operational_meaning: Statistical mixing, convex state body, extreme points (pure states)

primitives.name: TENSOR_COMPOSITION
primitives.operational_meaning: Composite systems, correlation tensors, Schmidt bipartitions

primitives.name: GROUP_ACTION
primitives.carrier: Transformation group action G x M -> M (e.g. SL(2,C)^n, SU(d))
primitives.operational_meaning: Symmetries, local operational equivalence, invariant polynomials

primitives.name: QUOTIENT_EQUIVALENCE
primitives.operational_meaning: Orbit space, quotient manifold coordinates, resolving representational collisions

primitives.name: AFFINE_OBSERVATION
primitives.operational_meaning: Frame measurement, probability readout, informational completeness

primitives.name: RELATIONAL_EXTENSION
primitives.carrier: Coupling to reference / ancilla space id (x) Phi
primitives.operational_meaning: Choi state isomorphism, composite test for positivity

primitives.name: COMPATIBILITY_TOPOLOGY
primitives.carrier: Context hypergraph H = (V, E) / sheaf cohomology
primitives.operational_meaning: Commutativity cliques, contextuality obstructions (F_2 parity contradiction)

primitives.name: ORDERED_COMPOSITION
primitives.carrier: Non-commutative semigroup / monoid Phi_2 o Phi_1
primitives.operational_meaning: Temporal sequence, dynamical flow, operational history

primitives.name: POSITIVITY_ADMISSIBILITY
primitives.carrier: Convex cone C (x in C iff spectrum(x) >= 0)

primitives.name: INFORMATION_LOSS_NULLSPACE
primitives.operational_meaning: Observational collision, projection loss, grammar escalation trigger
